MovieData.Paula.WinterMovie0.Love.Before: Winterstar movies are usually heartwarming.#$b#Do you think this one will be too?
MovieData.Paula.WinterMovie0.Love.AfterM: Haha, see? I told you!$h#$b#But even so, I still enjoyed the movie. Thank you, @.$h
MovieData.Paula.SpringMovie1.Like.Before: Oh, is this like a documentary?
MovieData.Paula.SpringMovie1.Like.AfterM: Although we were traveling in the army we weren't able to see the sights.#$b#It's nice to see different places though, even if it is from the screen.
MovieData.Paula.SummerMovie1.Like.Before: I heard from the others that this movie is hilarious.
MovieData.Paula.SummerMovie1.Like.AfterM: Oh my, that was indeed hilarious!$h#$b#I couldn't stop laughing even for a second.$h
MovieData.Paula.FallMovie1.Dislike.Befor: Uh, are you sure about this, @?
MovieData.Paula.FallMovie1.Dislike.After: I'm sorry I wasn't good company earlier.$s#$b#I just don't like frightening movies that much...$s
MovieData.Paula.WinterMovie1.Love.Before: Aww, a love story. This looks quite familiar.#$b#I wonder if it does look better in black and white.
MovieData.Paula.WinterMovie1.Love.During: They restored the movie beautifully, @. Don't you think so?
MovieData.Paula.WinterMovie1.Love.AfterM: That was very romantic.$4#$b#Imagine, spending your life with someone who's as passionate about you as you are for them.$4
MovieData.Sean.SpringMovie0.Like.BeforeM: Ooh, this looks nice.#$b#Trinnie and Keahi said they wanted to see this.$h
MovieData.Sean.SpringMovie0.Like.DuringM: Go, little sapling! I'm rooting for you!$h
MovieData.Sean.SpringMovie0.Like.AfterMo: It's fun to just sit back and enjoy something low-key, don't you think, @?$h
MovieData.Sean.SummerMovie0.Love.BeforeM: This game totally kicks my butt. I bet this movie will do the same!$h
MovieData.Sean.SummerMovie0.Love.DuringM: %Sean is grinning widely at all the action.
MovieData.Sean.SummerMovie0.Love.AfterMo: That was awesome!$h#$b#Trinnie, Keahi, and Blair would go nuts for this.$h
MovieData.Sean.FallMovie0.Like.AfterMovi: That was almost TOO much, haha. I'm still feeling a bit overwhelmed!$h
MovieData.Sean.WinterMovie0.Like.AfterMo: It was a good movie, I just couldn't really relate, you know? The relationship with me and my parents is a different vibe.
MovieData.Sean.SpringMovie1.Love.BeforeM: An educational movie, eh? Well, I'm always up for learning if it's interesting.$h
MovieData.Sean.SpringMovie1.Love.DuringM: Do you know I happen to know all the capitals of the cities in the world? Or at least I did at one time, haha.
MovieData.Sean.SpringMovie1.Love.AfterMo: Ah, my trivia-loving self is now satisfied.$h#$b#Alright, I gotta go find Blair, Trinnie, and Keahi and tell them all about it.$h
MovieData.Sean.SummerMovie1.Love.BeforeM: I heard Trinnie say that she saw someone coming out of the theater rolling on their backs laughing.#$b#Maybe this is the reason?
MovieData.Sean.SummerMovie1.Love.AfterMo: I gotta find out who the writers on that were! I wonder if they take fan mail?$h
MovieData.Sean.FallMovie1.Like.BeforeMov: Aw yeah, I like a good horror movie. It's kind of like pranking yourself.$h
MovieData.Sean.FallMovie1.Like.DuringMov: Yikes! Are you scared? I'm not too proud to admit I am!$u
MovieData.Sean.FallMovie1.Like.AfterMovi: That really sent chills down my spine.$u#$b#That was some good quality stuff, @.$h
MovieData.Sean.WinterMovie1.Dislike.Befo: Ugh, a romance movie? It's not that I don't like sappy stuff, but it goes a little too slow if that's all there is.
MovieData.Sean.WinterMovie1.Dislike.Duri: %Sean looks like he's having a hard time paying attention to the movie.
MovieData.Sean.WinterMovie1.Dislike.Afte: That movie would've been half the length if they'd have just shut up and kissed each other from the start.$a
MovieData.Shanice.SpringMovie0.Love.Befo: Kiarra said this movie was something I'd like.
MovieData.Shanice.SpringMovie0.Love.Duri: Aww that cute little sapling is on the journey of its life.$h
MovieData.Shanice.SummerMovie0.Dislike.A: I don't understand why you kids like video games so much.$a#$b#You could do so much more responsible things with your time don't you think?$s
MovieData.Shanice.FallMovie0.Like.Before: Mystery movies are a good exercise for the brain.#$b#Or so I've read. I have got to ask Paula or Philip about that. Maybe they know something about it.#$b#But let's enjoy the movie first.$h
MovieData.Shanice.FallMovie0.Like.AfterM: That was a rush.$h#$b#It was a nice movie, thank you.$h
MovieData.Shanice.WinterMovie0.Love.Befo: Miss Lola said that this movie was touching.#$b#I'm looking forward to watching this, come on.$h
MovieData.Shanice.WinterMovie0.Love.Afte: That was so beautiful.$4#$b#I hope that when I have my own family, we'll have each other's back like that.
MovieData.Shanice.SpringMovie1.Like.Afte: I can just imagine Lorenzo and I traveling in all those different places.#$b#That would be the dream!$4
MovieData.Shanice.SummerMovie1.Like.Befo: I heard Sean and Blair talking about this the other day. They said it was out of this world.
MovieData.Shanice.SummerMovie1.Like.Afte: I must admit that it was incredible funny.$h
MovieData.Shanice.FallMovie1.Dislike.Bef: %Shanice sighs.#$b#I don't think this is an appropriate movie to watch.
MovieData.Shanice.FallMovie1.Dislike.Dur: %Shanice looks bored? Or is she irritated?
MovieData.Shanice.FallMovie1.Dislike.Aft: I should have thought about it well before I said yes to your invitation.
MovieData.Shanice.WinterMovie1.Love.Befo: Don't you just love a good romance movie?#$b#I hope that they restored it in good condition.
MovieData.Shanice.WinterMovie1.Love.Afte: I'm quite thankful to have found a husband like the one in the movie.$h#$b#My Lorenzo's even so much more.$4
MovieData.Sonny.SpringMovie0.Love.Before: Isn't this a movie about nature?#$b#I think you'd like this as much as I do, @.$h
MovieData.Sonny.SpringMovie0.Love.AfterM: You see how nature works in wondrous ways?$h#$b#We should be glad that they are taking care of us.
MovieData.Sonny.SummerMovie0.Like.Before: Sir Louie mentioned this game last time.#$b#Now I wonder how they made it into a movie.
MovieData.Sonny.FallMovie0.Dislike.Befor: Oh my Yoba, you're telling me that you believe in illusions?$u
MovieData.Sonny.FallMovie0.Dislike.Durin: These types of movies play with the mind you know.$a#$b#They prey after the human brain.$u
MovieData.Sonny.FallMovie0.Dislike.After: Next time, @ choose your movies wisely okay?$s
MovieData.Sonny.WinterMovie0.Love.Before: Now this movie is about the winterstar?#$b#I believe this is definitely worth the money we're paying the theater.$h
MovieData.Sonny.WinterMovie0.Love.AfterM: Wasn't that wonderful?$4#$b#It's very touching to see families overcoming such obstacles in life.$h
MovieData.Sonny.SpringMovie1.Like.Before: The Madame would definitely recommend this movie for sure.
MovieData.Sonny.SpringMovie1.Like.During: Listen well, @. You could definitely learn a lot from this.
MovieData.Sonny.SpringMovie1.Like.AfterM: The Madame says we could use the different things we learn in our day to day lives.$4#$b#It's our weapon in life she says.
MovieData.Sonny.SummerMovie1.Love.Before: Oh is this a kid's movie?#$b#No? Haha that's okay, even if it was I would still like to see it.$h
MovieData.Sonny.SummerMovie1.Love.AfterM: My, my stomach hurts from laughing during the movie.$h#$b#They certainly got my funny bone.$h
MovieData.Sonny.FallMovie1.Like.BeforeMo: Ooh, this is exciting.$h#$b#I think people would think I'd get easily scared, but I know Yoba is always with me.
MovieData.Sonny.FallMovie1.Like.DuringMo: Don't worry, @. Yoba is here to guide and protect us.$h
MovieData.Sonny.FallMovie1.Like.AfterMov: That was fun!$h#$b#I used to watch these types of film while I was growing up, which us why I guess I don't feel scared anymore.$h
MovieData.Sonny.WinterMovie1.Like.Before: Ah, a classic just like me.$h
MovieData.Sonny.WinterMovie1.Like.During: %Sonny can't seem to take his eyes off the screen.
MovieData.Sonny.WinterMovie1.Like.AfterM: That was lovely.$h#$b#I'm happy that people have love in their life. We all deserve to be happy, don't you think?#$b#May Yoba give us everything we need and more.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: Hey, honey.$h#$b#Want me to take over spring planting for a while? These muscles could use a nice warmup.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: The egg festival's tomorrow!$h#$b#I bet I'll get more eggs than you!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: So, how does it feel that you get to dance tomorrow with the most handsome husband in the valley, honey?$h#$b#Aren't you glad you 'plucked' me from the bunch?$h#$b#Hm, that one needs work. I guess I haven't a-rose to the occasion.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: Shall we take some day trips up to Ridgeside, honey?#$b#Someone's got to check in on Ian, and I wouldn't mind sweating a little less in my binder.$u
Sean.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: The Luau is nice and all, but you know what the best part is?#$b#You-aw!$h#$b#Hey, you know luau puns are hard!
Sean.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: I don't have a favorite festival anymore.#$b#My only favorite is any time I spend with you, honey.$h#$b#You can tell this to the other festivals now, I'd be happy to make them jelly of you.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: Even if fall means a lot of harvest work for Ian and me, I promise I won't forget to make time for you.$l#$b#I'll just take a kiss for payment.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: I bet they'll be a lot of fun game booths at the fair tomorrow!$h#$b#Such a shame that some are rigged and don't play fair. Hah! Get it?
Sean.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: Jeric asked if I could spy on the girls during the festival.#$b#I told him gender-ally, such schemes are too trans-parent to work.#$b#Ahaha, two for one!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: Keep close to me tomorrow, aight?#$b#I'll protect you from the 'ghosts' and I'll bring some other 'spirits' for us to enjoy.$h#$e#On the other hand, I hope it doesn't rain.$s#$b#It'd sure dampen the spirits.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: I'm glad I'm actually not a bear during winter anymore.#$e#I know I said that hibernation sounds good, but I wouldn't want to miss any moments with you, honey.$4#$b#Though maybe we could hibernate together?$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: I hope you won't give me the cold shoulder if my puns for this one aren't very ice. I wouldn't want to igloo-se you!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: I don't need to make a wish for the Feast of the Winter Star anymore.$4#$b#Now, I have the star of my life. I'm feasting my eyes every day!$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.winter_27: Do you rem-ember me saying that I made the resolution not to make any more festival puns?#$b#Well, now that's ember-assing!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Sean.1: Hm, I don't know what I want to do today. My brain's going in five different directions.#$b#What do you think, honey?
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Sean.2: Honey! You are never going to believe what I just learned about orchids.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Sean.3: Huh, so *that's* why you can't divide by zero! It seems so obvious, and yet....
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Sean.4: So I started reading a bit on squash, thinking it might help the farm.#$b#Somehow, I've ended up reading about the biggest tsunamis recorded in the Gem Islands.#$b#I'm...not really sure how I ended up here, either.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Sean.5: Hey, @! Want to learn about how bees fly? Pull up a chair, this might run long.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.patio_Sean.1: Hey honey, help me with this word search? I can't find 'dependency'.#$b#Wait, why are you laughing?
Sean.MarriageDialogue.patio_Sean.2: Haha! Eat the combo of my magic cat, you evil reindeer!$h#$b#%It's a game on his phone...right?
Sean.MarriageDialogue.patio_Sean.3: Blair sent me some funny ADHD images. They're hilarious, but also, I think I've been psychologically skewered.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.patio_Sean.4: Having my phone and just looking at random nonsense is a little like meditation for me.#$b#If I actually tried to meditate, I'd get antsy after like ten seconds.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.patio_Sean.5: Hi babe, just taking a break doing nothing. Yep, completely normal-people relaxation here, it's great!#$b#...#$#...Yeah, I'm bored... I'm going to look up some recipes.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: Honey!$h#$b#Do you know that rain doesn't fall?#$b#%He grins at your blank expression..#$b#Rain-drops. Ahaha got you!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: I've never seen anyone as gorgeous as you are while wet, honey.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: I don't know why I have this feeling of longing for you whenever there's light rain...#$b#I guess I just mist you.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: It's amazing how easy it is to work when it's raining.#$b#I guess things just ran more fluidly.$4#$b#Hehe, get it honey?$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: Yikes, it's raining cats and dogs, honey.#$b#I think I saw Trinnie and Keahi stepping on a poodle earlier...$h#$b#Hahahaha! Okay, I'll stop with the puns.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Sean: Man, the texture of wet clothing on my skin is driving me nuts.#$b#What do you say we dry off by the fire, honey?
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: You ever wonder how rain actually works? I got curious, so I looked it up. I'll give you the deets tonight.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: All this time being surrounded by grains of rice and other crops are giving me a migraine.$u#$b#Get it? Our grains, give me my-grains.$h#$b#I probably shouldn't make so many puns, but I guess it's in-grained in me.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: What do you say we cuddle in front of the fire, honey? I pulled out my favorite blanket for you. It's microfleece!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: You know honey, I've been thinking about how the soil gets so rich...#$b#I guess it happens when Mother Nature makes it rain.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: The pitter-patter of rain's relaxing, isn't honey?$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: You're cute when you're wet, but when you're by the fire, you look really hot.$4#$b#It's a pun, but I'm also being serious, you know.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Sean: Are you cold, honey?#$b#Cuz I know a way that could warm you up...$4#$b# A competitive round of video games! Nothing says heat like butt-kicking or being butt-kicked, right?
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: Do you just roll out of bed looking that good? What's your secret? I don't mind stealing your tricks.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: I think my babysitting gigs will pay off.$h#$b#When we have our own kid, I'm gonna be the best dad ever!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: Ian says we've got a lot of jobs lined up in the next couple of days.#$b#Can you handle missing me, honey?$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: What are you going to be up to today, honey? If it's exciting, I want to hear all about it later.#$b#Who am I kidding, with you, everything is exciting!
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: I think you've got something in your eye, honey.#$b#%Sean cups your face in his hands.#$b#It's got the reflection of our bright future together.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Sean: There's something really nice with waking up next to the person you love.$4#$b#It's so much easier now for me to get up after you leave the bed, cause I wanna be with you.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: Whew, that was a long day, I'm wiped out!$s#$b#Although, I think I have juuust enough energy left for some "active cuddling"...$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: I think it's amazing what you do on our farm every day.#$b#Your ability to focus is incredible.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: %Sean's head seems to be up in the clouds.#$e#Oh! I'm sorry, honey.$h#$b#I was just thinking about my family and how they're doing.#$b#I kinda miss them? But I'm too lazy to travel far.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Want me to give you a massage? I love the feel of your skin under my hands.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: It's so quiet out here, I notice every little thing.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Sean: Shall we play a game tonight? The kind you can't play with kids.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: Hi honey! Just trying to keep these glutes in shape.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: Are you heading to Pierre's? If so, can you grab a charger cable for me? I can't find mine.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: Out enjoying the day, @? Good, I'm glad. Don't work too hard, now!
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: Do I still look good when I'm dripping in sweat? Wait, I'm not sure I want the answer to that.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: Hold on, there's something on your shirt.#$b#%Sean gives your nose a gentle flick.#$b#Got you!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Sean.1: I'm off to go give Ian a hand. Don't worry, I'll make sure he takes breaks.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Sean.2: Ian's got a two-man job for the day. He says it's not, but I know him.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Sean.3: I'm going to go help Ian today. I could probably stay plenty busy on the farm, but someone's got to look out for him. He'll work himself into the ground otherwise.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Sean.4: I'm giving Ian a hand today. I want a little pocket money so I can surprise you sometimes.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Sean.5: It's a little hard to get going today, but I told Ian I'd help him out, and I want him to be able to rely on me.#$b#I'll make you proud!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Sean.1: I'm back! Ian says hi and to give you a hug on his behalf, so...#$b#%Sean gives you a big bear hug.#$b#That's exactly like he would do it.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Sean.2: I'm back! Did you miss me?#$b#Hm, maybe you should work on your aim then.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Sean.3: Hi, honey! Ian sent you a present. I think he missed the innuendo of me giving this to you, though. I couldn't bear to tell him.[231]$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Sean.4: Surprise! I saw this and thought of you.[340]$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Sean.5: Oof, that was a workout! I am sore in places I should not be sore. If you want to give me a backrub, I won't complain!
Sean.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_0: Wow, babies are LOUD.$s#$b#No, it's fine, I'll get used to it, I just didn't expect how it hits your ears just so.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: Every day is a new adventure with kids. Today's was 'What is that smell on the baby?'#$b#You, uh, don't want to know the answer.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: Babies are so different from anything you could possibly expect. I'm having fun making all these new discoveries.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: I read that the stuff in my brain can be genetic. I'm a little relieved that %kid1 may not have to deal with that. I want them to start with every advantage in life.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_0: It's funny how different %kid1 and %kid2 are. I expected them to be more similar while they're babies, but they're already as different as Trinnie and Keahi.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: I'm handling all the gross stuff this time around, @. The smells and textures still squicks me, but %kid1 helped me build up a tolerance.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: Has there ever been a guy that's been as happy as me to be a stay at home dad, @? I doubt it!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: I just realized, all my puns can now be dad jokes!$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: I know people see me as a flake, which is why my parents gave me the boot.$s#$b#But I'm glad you see I've got my good points, too..#$e#Okay, time to focus and make you glad you married me!$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: Hey honey... want to get up close and personal with special parts of me?$4#$b#%Sean holds up a syringe.#$b#Guess what time it is?$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: I saw a thing somewhere that setting timers can help focus on the boring chores. It's actually helping a little bit!
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: Philip lent me one of his comics, but maybe you'd like to read it together? It's more fun when it's shared.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: Thanks for being my support, @. Being trans would be a lot rougher if I didn't have people like you in my life.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_5: I really appreciate how patient you are with me. I feel like you're the first person that's ever really understood how difficult stuff can be for me sometimes.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: You're working really hard lately. Don't burn yourself out, all right?
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: You know I'm always here for you if you need help relaxing. I've got a wealth of bad jokes and I'm dangerous in a tickle fight.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: You smell so good, @. Even when you've been out working the fields. I love the smell of sweat and earth on you.$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: I'm happiest when everyone around me is happy, too. That's why I like jokes so much. They can really turn your mood around.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: Honey, did you see where I put my meds? I swear, I need a neon sign for these things.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_1: Hm, I thought I put my other binder over here just the other day...#$b#That was two weeks ago? Well, that's still technically the other day, isn't it?$4
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_2: Oh, for crying out loud! I'm so mad at myself!$a#$b#It's just... It's the EGG festival. I could've been making trans jokes the entire time!$a
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: I'm thinking about learning to cook, for real. I figure if I switch up the kinds of cooking I do, I might be able to stick with it.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: It's weird, but I really like having you in charge. Sometimes, hearing you ask me to do something makes it all snap into place in my head.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_5: Hm, what kind of puns can you make with 'farm'? Let me see what rhymes with it.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_6: A good prank is like a pun: maybe people groan instead of laughing, but no one gets hurt. I'm trying to teach Keahi that one, too.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_7: Some folks think I haven't 'grown up', but I don't think you have to lose your sense of appreciation for silly little things just because you're bigger.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_8: Flor's got a colleague who's doing a transgender study. I'm kind of tempted to see if I can join in, not gonna lie.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: Just so you know, if you ever think about gender and decide it isn't what you thought it was, I'll love you no matter what you are.$h
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: Man, I can't focus for crap today.$s
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_1: Have we finally gotten tired of each other? I guess I expected it to happen one day.$s
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_2: Ugh, I was going to sweep the floors today, why can't I even get started?$s
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_3: You don't have to criticize everything I do, you know.$s
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_4: Maybe I should've just stayed single. I wouldn't have gotten my hopes up like this.
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_5: Man, I'm not good for anything, am I?$s
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_6: %Sean is staring off into space.#$b#Sorry...I'm just getting distracted easier nowadays.$s
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_7: Ow, my binder hurts this morning... guess it's another sports bra day.$s
Sean.MarriageDialogue.Bad_8: Sorry, I'm not really in the mood for jokes today.$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: The way the whole world melts overnight is like magic, don't you think?
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: Treasure, can you bring me some fresh eggs? I want to get an early start on this sabayon for tomorrow.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: If you want to dance with someone else, I won't be jealous.#$b#I mostly go to check out the cute dresses.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: I may have to change my wardrobe for the season. It's a lot hotter down here than it is on the Ridge.$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: Treasure, what are you going to put in the soup tomorrow? I'll coordinate my side dish.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: The moonlight jellies are one of my favorite things about the valley. They almost feel magical.#$b#Nature is amazing, isn't it?$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: Treasure, could you wear a coat please?$s#$b#You could ask Faye to make you one, just get some money from our funds and I promise I'll bring back more money than you spent. Plus, then we could match!$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: Do you want some help picking out things for your grange display?#$b#Or should I sabotage the competition? Bribe the judge?$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.fall_19: Don't tell anyone, star, but I find the whole girls vs. boys thing at the Gathering pretty silly. But it doesn't hurt them to let them have their fun.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: Shall we coordinate our outfits, treasure?$h#$b#We could go as a married monster couple!
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: A lot of people like fall the most, but I think winter's my favorite season. Snow's just so much fun.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: I won't tell you not to participate in the fishing competition. Just be gentle with the fish, okay?#$b#While you're trouncing the competition, of course.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: I'll give you your present after the Feast.#$b#Just make sure you have plenty of energy to receive it!$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Kiarr: Sorry if it's a bit cluttered. I'm not used to having this much space to decompress into.$4
Hi, treasure. Just checking my email. Hoping for good news for a project or two!
Hey, star, what do you think of this? If you like it, maybe I'll make a print of it.$h
Treasure, where's our recycling machine? Joja sent me some junk mail.#$b#It may as well have *some* use, right?
I think I'll rearrange my schedule for when I do my freelance work.#$b#I want plenty of time to spend with my treasure, after all.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.patio_Kiarra.1: Being on the farm is really inspirational for my design. It's so natural, but different from Ridgeside.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.patio_Kiarra.2: %Kiarra is rapidly scribbling notes onto a sketch.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.patio_Kiarra.3: The router Kenneth built for me is working really well. It really helps my productivity to work out here.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.patio_Kiarra.4: There are four hundred fonts on my tablet, so why can I not find one that fits?$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.patio_Kiarra.5: Seeing a view like this, it's hard to think that there are bad things in the world.#$b#I want to share this happiness with everyone.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_0: What is it about the sound of rain on a roof that makes it so soothing? I love just sitting and listening to it.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: Star, make sure you take a raincoat or umbrella, okay?#$b#If you catch a cold from doing something silly, I won't be gentle when I nurse you back to health.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: What do you say you make some progress on some indoor tasks today?#$b#It would be fun to work together, don't you think?$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: Treasure, have you seen my sketch book?#$b#I was *sure* I left it under *that* pile, but it's not there.$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: %Kiarra seems to be drawing something on her sketchbook.#$b#Hey, treasure! Stop moving please, I gotta finish sketching your smoldering eyes first.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_Kiarra: Yeah, rain can be bothersome for us humans, but the rest of nature sure seems to appreciate it.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_0: The staccato of rain on the roof is so relaxing.$h#$b#Know what would make this even better? You, me, your big swole arms...$4#$b#No, I'm not talking about arm wrestling, you goofball!$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: Do you hear that? The wind coming off the mountainside makes such a howling noise.#$b#Am I weird for thinking it's comforting? It's like a big gigantic hug of the night.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: I was getting ready to take a walk outside earlier when the rain started.$u#$b#So much for connecting with the great outdoors.$s#$b#But I guess it worked out since I was able to get some gigs done. Now I have more time for you, treasure.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: Wanna go splash around in some puddles? Let's see who can get the dirtiest.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: Wouldn't it be cool if we had a hammock inside the house? Just in a little corner over there. I could make it my 'thinking area'.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: Welcome back, treasure. Did you miss me?#$b#I would say I missed you, but I'm not much of a 'miss', huh?$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_Kiar: Shall we shove off to bed, treasure?$h#$b#I'm bushed, and the rain is gonna lull me right to sleep.#$b#Don't make me wait too long, @.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_0: Treasure? What do you think about expanding?#$b#The house! I was actually talking about the house. You know, more space means more room for inspiration and freedom to express oneself!$3#$b#But... if you had a different kind of expansion to the household in mind... I mean, we could talk about it.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: It's funny how a computer can connect you with the rest of the world.#$b#Even in our tiny corner of the world, we can still do so much.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: I've been thinking about a new campaign to raise awareness about climate change.#$b#So many people don't take it seriously or just give up.$a#$b#You'll support me won't you, treasure?
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: What are your plans for today, star?#$b#I'm trying to wrap some things up so that I can try and spend the day with you.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: Are you excited to conquer your day, star?$h#$b#Eat a good breakfast first before you go out into the world, okay? Gotta keep your strength up if you're gonna change the world.$h#$e#I'll try to catch up with you later, alright? I want to spend time with you outside before we get home.$h#$b#A healthy stroll keeps the spirit alive, so we'll feel even more alive when we do it together, right, treasure?$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_Kiarr: Hmm, I'm thinking about visiting my brothers soon.#$b#Would you do me the honor of accompanying me, treasure? We'll have a big family picnic.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_0: I've been studying my parents' language a bit more, want to hear it?#$b#Buona notte! Good night, and ti amo, tesoro mio. I love you, my treasure.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: Man, I'm beat.$s#$b#The day has been so long, treasure. Come cuddle me before I fall asleep?$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: Have you given some thought on what you want our wallpaper to be?#$b#I'm planning to make a custom one for our room.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Treasure, do you think that a skylight would be nice?#$b#Just imagine stargazing together from our bed.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: Having trouble sleeping? I could always serenade you with a traditional power ballad.$h#$e#When your jaw opens wide, and there's more teeth inside, that's a moray~$h#$b#Put your hand in a crack, and you won't get it back, 'cause a moray~
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_Kia: Hey, I know I'm not great at being vulnerable, but... I really like coming home to you.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_0: Drink your water, treasure.#$b#Don't forget to hydrate! Wouldn't want you collapsing from thirst or heat stroke somewhere.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: I'll catch up to you later, treasure. I still have to do errands for Lenny and Paula.#$b#I can't wait to see you later.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: I heard Anton and Lorenzo had another spat.$a#$b#I'm going to knock their heads together until they behave.$a
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: Treasure, you seen my pen?#$b#No, that's the .7 thickness, I really need the .3.$s#$b#That's a huge difference in line thickness!$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: I always figured I'd be independent and carefree forever, but some days, I just want nothing more than to be with you.$4.
Hey treasure, I'm kind of missing my brothers, so I'm going to go pick a few fights with them today.$h#$b#Don't worry, we won't acquire *too* many bruises!$h
I'm off to work!#$b#I've got people counting on me, so you can't keep me *all* to yourself.$h
If you get your butt whipped in the mines today, let me know so I can bring you some bandages from Tita Paula.
I'm off to Ridgeside! Come by and see me if you've got a chance.$h
I'm going to my part-time job today. I left you a little sketch in your bag for when you miss me. Don't get too lonely, now!$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Kiarra: I got off a bit early today, so you know what this means? Dinner from Pika's!$h
I took the long way to Ridgeside today. The Hike is such a nice stretch to walk.$h
I'm home, treasure! Hope you had a good harvest and gave the mine-monsters what for!
Living on the farm and working in Ridgeside is so great. The variation in my routine really helps my moods.
Hi, star! I hope you didn't work *too* hard today, because now it's time for us to play!$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_0: Ohoho! Look at that, treasure!#$b#Looks like a mini you! It's so adorable!$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: Look at that kid run around, treasure!$h#$b#Bet that energy comes from my side of the family.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: You know, I used to think having kids would be a distraction from bigger work, but....#$b#It's like a different measure of changing the world, yeah?$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: Our little one's growing so fast.$s#$b#Do you think I grew up that quickly? I was the youngest, so....
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_0: You and the kids mean everything to me, treasure.#$b#Together with Shanice and my brothers, my family is the greatest inspiration I have in my life.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: They're growing so fast, aren't they?#$b#It seems like just yesterday it was just the two of us in the house.$h#$b#What a great force of chaos we've unleashed upon the world, huh?$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: I didn't think I'd make a good parent, honestly, since I wasn't really big on kids in general.$s#$b#But I guess it's a little different when they're your own family and you know them.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: We have got to visit my brothers soon, treasure. They've been telling me they want to see their little figlioccio- their godchildren.$h#$b#They'll be bugging us soon if we don't visit them soon enough.$u
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: I really like it that we're now living together.#$b#You make a great rubber duck whenever I'm trying to figure out a problem.$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: What do you say we plan a picnic sometime?#$b#It's never a bad time to have a meal together with family!$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: There is a method to my organizing madness, I swear.#$b#It's just, uh, covered in too much madness to be able to tell.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: You know, most of the major brands of body paint have stopped testing on animals.#$b#What do you say, treasure? Want to donate your body for art?$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: I often find myself in awe of you, treasure.$4#$b#You've always had this can-do spirit that gets everyone going.#$b#It makes me really glad, that we chose each other.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_5: Lorenzo and Shanice have been asking about wanting to make an addition to the family.#$b#I'm not really sure whether they meant themselves or us.$u#$b#Have you thought about it, treasure?$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: Someone from Zuzu City contacted me about a potential art assignment.#$b#It's a remote gig, thankfully. I wouldn't want to be separated from my treasure!$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: I saw a little kiwi rolling around earlier. It made me think of you.$h#$b#I don't know, I found it adorable to see a kiwi just rolling around without stopping.$h#$b#It's unique, just like you are, treasure.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: I know I don't tell you what you mean to me as often as you deserve it.$s#$b#But rest assured, in everything I do, I always bring you with me. Like, the thought of you gives me purpose, makes me feel like I could do more than I could alone.#$b#With you, treasure... I found something that changed *my* world.$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: Hm? Oh, I was just thinking about my wedding outfit.$4#$b#I know it might not have been a traditional dress, but it really made me feel like the most beautiful person in the world.$4#$b#After you, of course!$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: People can be so selfish sometimes.$s#$b#I think when you lose empathy for others, you really lose a part of what makes a human, human.$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_1: I've never really been inclined to be 'girly' like Ysa or Alissa. You... don't mind that, right?$4
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_2: It's funny how people take everything for granted.#$b#Time, nature, other people? All of them are taken for granted.#$b#It makes you question humanity at times
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: I think it would be nice to spend the day in the mines.#$b#I think the darkness would do me good there, maybe I can get myself to think.#$b#If you're going to join me though you must tell me, so that I can have Paula prepare a bed at the clinic, haha!$h
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: It's a relief to have a change of scenery every once in a while.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_5: I'm going to visit my brothers, @. Would you like to come with me, treasure?
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_6: Do you remember the first time that we held hands?#$b#That was a new core memory for me.$h#$b#And to be honest, the feeling that I felt at that time? I used it to make my artwork called 'Tesoro Mio' or 'My Treasure'.$4#$b#But it didn't turn out the way I wanted, so I'm going to redo it before I give it to you. No peeking!
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_7: I've been considering some trips into Zuzu to join in the activist meetings there. Would you be okay if I'm gone for a while?
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_8: It's crazy that people have to pay so much for the basics to stay alive.#$b#We form a society to take care of each other. What good is it if we don't do that?
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: Sean told me about this article where they've developed biodegradeable plastic.#$b#It's kind of exciting, don't you think?
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: I still have a lot to do.$a#$b#I don't have time for your drama, please.$a
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_1: It's so pathetic how people in the world seem when you start to see their true colors.$a#$b#*Well, if the shoe fits...$a
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_2: One of the things I hate the most is when people have no backbone.$a#$b#They have no stand in life, like you– and it's just sad to see you like this.$s#$b#I pity you, @. You weren't like this when I first fell in love with you.$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_3: I'm tired of the fighting.$a#$b#I just don't care about what you do anymore.$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_4: I don't understand you anymore!$a#$b#I mean like it's up to the point that I'm questioning your character!$a#$b#And I'm questioning myself why I chose you, of all people to fall for.$s
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_5: I'm going to my brothers for a while, then I'll bury myself in work.$s#$b#I just don't want to see you for a while.$a
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_6: Have you ever thought of going back to the city, ever since you got here, @?#$b#Like that feeling you could have gone far there, and made a big change in the world?#$b#Oh, nothing's bothering me, haha. I was just... curious.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_7: Yeah? What's up?#$b#Oh nothing. I'm just tired, that's all.
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_8: I still have some protest posters to make, and I'm pretty sure you have something else better to do with your time than follow me around.$a
Kiarra.MarriageDialogue.Bad_9: Scusami– excuse me.#$b#I hope you respect my boundaries and leave me alone because I don't think I could look at you the way I used to.$s

RSV.secretnote.-75160: Miner's Diary, Chapter 1^^Summer 4th, Year -504^We set up a proper camp in this place a couple of weeks ago and I've already seen something you just would not believe. The other night a darned star fell right out of the sky and landed into that valley just a few kilometers down south. Now a group of people are thinking of going to scope it out, see if it's dangerous or not-- Maybe it could be useful to us.^^Summer 17th, Year -504^The scouts just came back the other night, said that star was nowhere to be found just a hole and some rubble where it should be. Though they said that valley was something to behold, even without the star. An abundant land with apparently more forage to be had and fish to catch than we'd know what to do with. Said it's even got quarry filled with ore on the eastern side. Sounds like as perfect a place as any to set up a proper town. The rest of us are gonna make our way on over after we pack up the rest of camp. It takes about 3 days time on horseback.^^Fall 22nd, Year -504^After about a month's time, we finally got something set up that we could call a town. There was a nice spot between the mountain and the ocean that we decided to settle down in. It's a good town for fishing and mining. We decided to call it Pelican Town. Once we get some boats up and running this could have a real nice bustling port going on, should bring in new people to the valley. The wildlife here is all friendly, too, 'cept for the monsters in the cave by the mountain. But there's this little turtle we found when we started settling, been real fond of us. It seems like the little feller has been here for quite a bit, but it's nice to have him around to keep us company.
RSV.secretnote.-75161: Miner's Diary, Chapter 2^^Winter 20th, Year -504^Life in this valley has started to show its share of difficulty. I thought the monsters in the mines were a big enough problem, but the cold here is like nothing I have ever encountered before. No crops can grow in this brutal cold, 'cept for these snow yams you see rarely, though there's not enough for the town to survive on. We've barely been getting by on fishing, but the rations we made before winter have been running low. I'm starting to fear what'll happen to this town. Some of the towns folk are gonna trek up the mountain, see if they can't find some forage up there. I'm doubtful... but hell, what do we have to lose?^^Winter 22nd, Year -504^Folks in town have been talking about that bright star in the sky... For some reason we have only been able to see just how bright it is this winter. Some of the more superstitious folks have been saying it brings good luck and we're blessed to see it. With how this winter has been going, I wonder if we're blessed or cursed to be here. I will say, though, that there is something comforting about seeing that light in the sky.^^Winter 24th, Year -504^We lost some people to the cold these past few days. I just hope we don't lose any more. The forage team just got back and they were at least able to find some food. Sadly, not enough to last longer than a day or two. But maybe our luck will change... Winter shouldn't last too much longer, so we just gotta hold on until spring comes. I've been trying to give some of the kids and the older folks a bite of my share of food. Yoba knows they need it more than I do. I even gave a bit of my ration to that little turtle in town-- Don't know how the feller is surviving in this weather, let alone finding food. Least I can do is give him some food and a blanket to keep 'im warm.^^Winter 25th, Year -504^By Yoba, a damned miracle happened today. When I awoke and came out this morning, I found my yard filled with them snow yams! Apparently the mariners said their fishing lines were filled as well! It's like Yoba heard our cries and came to feed us themselves. Even one of the stars down in the Alden's house turned into this purple fruit. I don't know what happened last night, but I won't question these gifts. Thanks to this miracle, we can make it to spring without worry.
RSV.secretnote.-75162: Dear Governor,^^   I think your proposal to build a new town in the neighboring mountains is most likely our best course of action. With the new railway being built into our town, there has been a marked influx of travelers here. Also, with a possible war looming, I'm worried about what could happen to our town. It's over two centuries old, and was built without defense in mind. That being said, some of the folks in town went with me to scope out an area to start construction. I think we found just the place-- There's a nice flat spot with a river going through it, leading from a waterfall to the north. I saw something strange up there, though-- A tortoise... Isn't that just peculiar? I've heard stories of a tortoise being around when Pelican Town was created... I guess he must be an ancestor of his.^But I digress. I did want to mention that it would be difficult to haul all the needed construction materials up the mountain. If we have the funding, maybe it would be best to have one of those new funiculars built? Well, just let me know your thoughts on the matter, and if you agree, we can get started right away.^^   - Mayor Maynard^^P.S. I'm thinking of naming it "Ridgeside Village"-- Sounds quaint, don't you think?
